description: `restart` or `stop` after a countdown with warnings in chat, saving every world and player first. Docker's restart policy or a start script loop starts it again (then a stop is a restart too), otherwise it stays off. One is pending at a time: scheduling replaces it, `cancel` calls it off, and get_server_status with include restart shows it. Everyone gets disconnected: confirm with the user first.

message.description: Said with each warning, such as the reason
